elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: HDI must, at the Company's request, provide transition assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is provided “at HDI's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: HDI must return the defined Company Data to the Company within 30 days after expiration or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires Company Data to be returned “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After return, HDI must delete Company Data from its systems and certify the deletion in writing to the Company.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The clause permits assistance “for up to” six months but does not guarantee at least 90 days; no minimum duration is stated.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: HDI must return all defined Company Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiration or termination, satisfying the export requirement.
